canonical_edition: Sicyonii fragmenta aliunde nota, ed. Sandbach, op. cit., 284–286. Pap: 94: Comic. frr. 1–6, 10–11.
sources_tested: Local corpus paths (no tlg0541 text); exact Perseus work/edition catalogue search; Arnott 1997 open paper, pp.1–10, witness list inspection; targeted Suda/Photius/Stobaeus/Plato Symposium citation searches; Sorbonne principal-witness and rights check
open_text_result: No reusable exact text of Sandbach's assembled frr.1–6 and 10–11 was verified.
scan_result: No scan is appropriate until each externally transmitted fragment is mapped to its own witness. Arnott's open discussion identifies the title-attesting loci for book fragments 1, 3–5, 7–8 in Photius/Suda, fr.2 in Stobaeus, fr.6 in Plato Symposium 195b, and fr.9 in Pollux 4.119; this is an item-level witness map, not a licence for Sandbach's edition or a proof that all Canon fragments are available in an open text corpus.
next_action: validate each numbered fragment against its quoted ancient witness and then retain only independently licensed source passages
notes: Arnott's article is used solely to locate the ancient transmission: it explicitly distinguishes book fragments from the Sorbonne papyrus. The CC-BY-NC Sorbonne images for the main play do not license these external fragments. No provider OCR or image was downloaded.
